name: Baked Aloo Tikki
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 2 small potatoes (200 g), boiled and mashed
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each cumin, chaat masala and amchur
Mint chutney and chopped onion, to serve
steps: Mix the potato, chickpeas, besan, chilli, ginger, coriander, spices and salt into a dough.
Place on a lined tray and brush lightly with oil.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
note: Mashed chickpeas replace some of the potato, adding protein and slowing the carbohydrate release.
